name: Aerocool P500B Digi Panoramic ARGB Case Black
shortDescription: Aerocool P500B Digi Panoramic Glass Mid Tower Gaming Case (Dot-Pixel LED Hardware Monitor Display / 4 Pre-Installed ARGB PWM Fans / Reverse Connector BTF Motherboard Support / USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C / Vertical GPU Ready

specs.label: Integrated Display Screen
specs.value: Dot-Pixel LED Screen (3 Display Modes: Time / CPU / GPU / RAM Stats)

specs.label: Motherboard Compatibility
specs.value: Standard & BTF Reverse Connector ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

specs.label: Glass Panel Design
specs.value: Full Tempered Glass Front & Snap-Fit Side Panels

specs.label: Pre-Installed Fans
specs.value: 4 Fans (3x 120mm Side Reversed ARGB PWM + 1x 120mm Rear ARGB PWM)

specs.label: Liquid Cooling Support
specs.value: Top Radiator Support Up To 360mm / Side Radiator Support Up To 360mm

specs.label: GPU Mounting & Clearance
specs.value: Up To 425mm Length (Supports Horizontal & Vertical GPU Mounting)

specs.label: CPU Cooler Clearance
specs.value: Supports CPU Air Coolers Up To 170mm Height

specs.label: Front IO Interface
specs.value: 1x USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C + 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A + HD Audio

specs.label: Product Warranty
specs.value: 1-Year Official Local Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل)
